objective: A fully learned six-input/three-score MLP consistently beats original Selfplay v2 and unchanged scripted attacker, without fixed geometry or paddle-feedback branches.

guardrail_opponents.interceptor: training/scripts/env.py:scripted(obs, attack=False); reported, not a primary acceptance target

candidate_selection.data: Training seeds below 1,000,000,000; development seeds in [1,300,000,000,1,400,000,000). Prior public final tests are historical evidence, never fresh evaluation.
candidate_selection.freeze: Before final evaluation, save candidate checkpoint and exported ONNX SHA256 plus the development selection evidence. Do not select or retune using holdout outcomes.
candidate_selection.previous_tests: Published v1/v2/v3 and hybrid Strategist tests are historical, not fresh evidence for this candidate.

holdout.sampling: Three disjoint uint32 intervals;200 unique dispersed seeds per block;Python random.Random samplers611/612/613.

evaluation.candidate: Actual exported ONNX through native ONNX Runtime, deterministic first argmax.
evaluation.learned_reference: Actual frozen selfplay-v2.onnx through native ONNX Runtime.
evaluation.scripted_reference: Unmodified deterministic attacker using only the six policy inputs.
evaluation.matches: Each seed: all five serves, both physical side assignments; aggregate ten-rally point margins.
evaluation.termination: Fixed v3 1,600-tick limit and exact post-contact loop detection for these fixed deterministic stateless controllers.

bootstrap.unit: whole seed: both sides and all five rallies remain together
intervals: mean rally point margin (wins minus losses per rally)
score_rate = wins plus half draws per rally

report: paired ten-rally match outcomes including draws
ordinary five-rally game W/L/D and win rate including draws

acceptance.scope: All previous paired-match/positive-margin/both-side criteria PLUS majority ordinary five-rally game wins must pass against both primary targets in each of three fresh blocks.
acceptance.paired_match_win_rate: Strictly greater than 0.5, counting drawn matches in the denominator.
acceptance.point_margin_interval: Lower endpoint of seed-cluster 95% bootstrap confidence interval strictly greater than zero.
acceptance.side_fairness: Rally wins strictly exceed rally losses separately on left and right.
acceptance.failure: Report failure or mixed evidence honestly. Do not silently select another candidate on these same holdouts.
acceptance.interpretation: These are predeclared empirical acceptance thresholds, not a proof of optimal play or a family-wise statistical guarantee.
acceptance.ordinary_match_win_rate: Strictly greater than0.5 for ordinary five-rally games, counting drawn games in the denominator, against each primary opponent in every block.

architecture_requirement.input: Original six float32 observations only; no engineered geometry features.
architecture_requirement.output: Three learned action scores, deterministic first argmax.
architecture_requirement.network: Plain feed-forward MLP with learned affine weights/biases and Tanh/ReLU hidden nonlinearities. Every affine tensor must correspond to a trainable checkpoint parameter. No fixed feature branches, paddle-error feedback, external planner, opponent identity or time inputs to the actor.
architecture_requirement.initialization: May fine-tune a fully learned existing actor. Training opponents and training-only critic are unrestricted; submitted policy has no privileged inputs.
